identity.copyIdentity: immutable copyId; never infer copy from materialId
identity.deliveryBinding: one immutable bindingId per student, context, placement and pin set

authorityModel.owner: #102 private-owner Course path: actor, Course owner, context owner, issuer.ownerId, and accepted Book publication owner match. Public/external reference or fork authority belongs to #106.
authorityModel.enrolment: Student must pass existing Course/Class enrolment and module access before a Book entitlement is issued.
authorityModel.teacherVisibility: Only teacher-owned Course/Class attempts/results are visible to their authorized teacher context.

compatibility.legacyMode: Mode 1 bare materialId readers remain readable only for existing non-Book placements.
compatibility.newBookRule: New Book placements require courseMaterialId, context kind, copy identity, all exact pins, and delivery binding; bare materialId is rejected.
compatibility.migration: Additive dual-read: retain legacy reader, branch Book reads on explicit placement record, backfill only by explicit teacher-approved migration.
compatibility.rollback: Disable new Book placement writes and entitlement issuance; retain immutable bindings, pins, legacy data, and existing readable records without deletion.

invalidation.rollback: deny new issuance; retain immutable records

enrollmentAuthorityPort.owner: #102 direct-Course vertical; contributes through #59 Worker composition
enrollmentAuthorityPort.directCourseOnly: Reject class-based enrollmentType and class cleanup; #103 owns Class enrollment/copies.
enrollmentAuthorityPort.create: Require one active exact record; identical replay returns the stored revision; a competing active legacy record or authority record denies conflict.
enrollmentAuthorityPort.expiry: At read and transition, expiresAt <= trusted now changes authority status to expired and denies eligibility.
enrollmentAuthorityPort.removal: Unenrolment writes revoked status/revision; immutable Book placement/history is retained.
enrollmentAuthorityPort.migration: Explicit one-course-at-a-time bounded activation gate maps one legacy random-ID direct-Course row to the deterministic key, denies duplicates/overflow, and never migrates Class rows.
enrollmentAuthorityPort.rollback: Disable new deterministic-key transitions; retain canonical rows as deny-only and preserve legacy non-Book enrollment data.
enrollmentAuthorityPort.recovery: Restore/replay is side-effect suppressed unless the approved recovery phase explicitly invokes the port.

courseAuthorityAdapter.compatibility: Legacy random enrollment IDs and bare-materialId non-Book readers remain untouched; only Book placement uses the additive exact projections.
courseAuthorityAdapter.legacyMaterialLinkCompatibility: materialLinkManager.linkMaterialToModule/copyMaterialToModule/unmountMaterialFromModule remain legacy non-Book writers and are never trusted Book authority producers.
courseAuthorityAdapter.classBoundary: #103 owns Class locks, class progress, copies, and class-course identity; this adapter never reads class_progress or class copies.
